# Retrieve cached flight results
departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="departure_flights")
return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="return_flights")

# Retrieve cached filtered flight results
filtered_departure_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_departure_flights")
filtered_return_flights = get_results_from_cache(key="filtered_return_flights")

# Search for hotels in St. Louis
hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    checkin_date=["2026-06-05"],
    checkout_date=["2026-06-12"]
)

# Save hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="st_louis_hotels", value=hotels)

# Search for nearest attractions in St. Louis
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="St. Louis"
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="st_louis_attractions", value=attractions)

# Find nearest attractions to hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions_to_hotels", value=nearest_attractions)
